svg.title: eval-stand-for-agents architecture
svg.desc: The macOS desktop client and benchmark runner use Gateway HTTP and a reverse SSH tunnel. An SSHFS volume driver exposes the local folder at /work in the session sandbox. Codex app-server sends inference to the LLM proxy and tools to the sandbox through the manager.
svg.text: eval-stand-for-agents · task and tool execution flow
Mounted client · session lifecycle, agent tools and file access
Docker-managed Linux VM · shared Linux kernel
